# CodePipelinePhaseExecution

How one phase of a code pipeline run is going, with its steps.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `phaseName` | `string` | The phase's name. |
| `status` | [`CodePipelinePhaseExecutionStatus`](code-pipeline-phase-execution-status.md) | Where the phase is. |
| `dateStart` | `datetime \| null` | When the phase started, in UTC. Null until it starts. |
| `dateEnd` | `datetime \| null` | When the phase ended, in UTC. Null until it ends. |
| `steps` | [`CodePipelineStepExecution`](code-pipeline-step-execution.md)`[]` | The phase's steps, from the definition plus any added for the run or by hooks. |
| `failureDetails` | `string \| null` | Why the phase failed. Null unless it did. |
| `hookPreOutput` | `string \| null` | What the phase's `preHook` returned, as JSON. Null when it has none or returned nothing. |
| `hookPostOutput` | `string \| null` | What the phase's `postHook` returned, as JSON. Null when it has none or returned nothing. |
